harness.name: GPTCode
harness.provenance: Historical runs used a precursor working tree later incorporated into the published revision; the exact transient build commit was not retained.

campaigns.purpose: Determine whether the configuration can satisfy the strengthened contract at least once.
Measure three clean repetitions with the same committed suite configuration.

limitations: The exact transient source commit used to build the historical runner was not retained.
The capability patch passed the fixture but retained a possible symlink check-to-write race.
GPU residency was observed through Ollama telemetry rather than an independent profiler.
One capability pass and a later repeatability campaign are reported separately rather than combined.
